tools.name: about_eous
tools.description: What Eous is, what it does and does not do, and how to work with Forged Lucidity. Read this before submitting.

tools.name: submit_claim
tools.description: Send one claim to be checked at its primary source and graded. Returns a receipt ID. A person reviews every submission before any answer is released; nothing is instant.

tools.name: contact_us
tools.description: Send a question, or a scoping, partnership or press message. Returns a receipt ID. A person reads every message before anyone replies; nothing is instant.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Look up a claim or a message by its receipt ID. Shows the answer once a person has released it.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_status · Private data: contact_us · Public sink: submit_claim, contact_us.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_status · Private data: contact_us · Public sink: submit_claim, contact_us

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
